headline: Mind and body are connected—each influences the other in continuous feedback loops
universal_truth: You can't separate mind and body; change one and you change the other; they're one system
fun_facts: Smiling actually makes you feel happier—even a forced smile shifts mood
Physical posture affects confidence levels—stand tall to feel more confident
Gut bacteria influence brain chemistry—your microbiome affects your mood
discussion_questions: How does your body state affect your mental state?
How do your thoughts affect your physical feelings?
What feedback loops exist between your mind and body?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Feel anxious? Your heart races, muscles tense, breathing quickens. Feel depressed? Your body slouches, energy drains, movements slow. Mind and body aren't separate—they're one system influencing each other constantly.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: We often treat mind and body as separate. But they're deeply connected. What does this mean practically?

options.text: Mind and body are one system—changing physical state changes mental state and vice versa; you can use either door to influence the whole system
options.response: Yes. Feeling anxious? Change your breathing, and your mind calms. Stuck mentally? Move your body, and thinking shifts. Two doors to the same room. Use whichever is accessible.
The brain influences the body, but the body also influences the brain—it's bidirectional...

q1.title: Bidirectional Influence
q1.script: Brain affects body: anxiety creates tension. Body affects brain: tension creates anxiety. The influence runs both ways. You can intervene from either direction.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Bidirectional Influence"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Physical Backdoor
q2.script: Can't change your thoughts? Change your body. Exercise lifts mood. Power poses increase confidence. Deep breathing reduces anxiety. The body provides access to the mind.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Mental Backdoor
q3.script: Can't change your body? Change your mind. Visualization improves physical performance. Reframing reduces physical stress responses. Mental training has physical effects.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: You can't separate mind and body. Change one and you change the other. They're one system with two doors.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 307. Tomorrow, we'll explore how fast you can respond—reaction time. Until then, notice mind-body connections in your experience.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Mind-Body Mapping - What Connections Do You Notice?
growTrack.activity: When you feel stressed, what happens in your body? When you're tired physically, what happens to your mood? Map your mind-body connections. Which door is easier to access when you need change?
